issue_context.title: Code refine for `hasExtralPidCol` function
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement
We do some implicit assumptions between plan and execute in `hasExtralPidCol` function. But when these assumptions are not true, an error may not be reported, so it is necessary to check these in the executor part.
